title: Polynomial-Time Decidability of Palindromes
statement: The language of binary words equal to their reversals belongs to polynomial time: there is a natural number $c$ such that a finite deterministic multi-tape Turing machine decides it within $a(n^c+1)$ steps on every binary input of length $n$, for some natural number $a$.
replaced:
The language of binary palindromes — the set of words $x \in \{0,1\}^*$ equal to
their own reversal — belongs to the class $\mathsf{P}$ of languages decidable by
a multi-tape Turing machine in time polynomial in the input length.
